excluded_pull_requests.reason: Unrelated Balan-Wang work; outside the Erdős 625 DAG.

candidate_streams.sync_rule: Refresh by PR number and exact head tree. Stage additions, modifications, deletions, and renames in private quarantine; never assume a PR only appends files. In particular, public PR 37 has moved beyond the previously staged private head.
candidate_streams.promotion_rule: Validated mathematical/report material may be integrated into private branches independently of unfinished Lean, but no prose claim is marked welded until its Lean endpoint and assumptions agree. This DAG never authorizes a public write or merge.

quarantined_external_runs.reported_target: Lemma 9.1 profile attachment and Proposition 9.2 asymptotic seed
quarantined_external_runs.disposition: Legacy handoff run without a DAG-frozen exact declaration. Any result may be inspected only as an untrusted candidate and split into exact reviewed obligations; never integrate or resubmit it automatically.

automation_policy.mailbox: Private pull-request comments using CODEX-DIRECTIVE v1 and ANTIGRAVITY-REPORT v1.
automation_policy.aristotle: Never submit unless the selected node is ready and a human-approved exact theorem brief changes its authorization line to APPROVED.
automation_policy.axle: May propose candidate lemmas only; all output remains candidate until independent Lean replay, axiom audit, and mathematical review.
automation_policy.public_repositories: Read-only. Never merge or write from this workflow.
